SlaveBranding.BrandDef.label: Brand of Service
SlaveBranding.BrandDef.description: A mark of hard-won obedience. The bearer works faster, but holds them back in every conversation.

SlaveBranding.BrandDef.label: Brand of Chains
SlaveBranding.BrandDef.description: The bearer is held fast and stays docile. Slave suppression lasts far longer, and they rarely think of rebellion. They have little left to say for themselves.

SlaveBranding.BrandDef.label: Brand of Pain
SlaveBranding.BrandDef.description: Feeling runs shallow beneath the mark. The bearer shrugs off what should floor them, and rarely goes down from pain. Still, they have little left to say for themselves.

SlaveBranding.BrandDef.label: Brand of Pleasure
SlaveBranding.BrandDef.description: The bearer draws others in and holds attention easily. Their focus wanders, and work suffers for it.
